Hong Kong and Dubai Report Post-Pandemic Visitor Surges

Hong Kong recorded its highest monthly visitor arrivals since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic in August. Similarly, Dubai saw its highest visitor numbers since February of the same year, with 869,000 arrivals. These figures indicate a significant recovery in tourism for both cities following the global health crisis.
